title: RAG ingestion: chunk boundaries, metadata and citations
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects rag ingestion: chunk boundaries, metadata and citations with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. The support assistant must answer CI troubleshooting questions from synthetic approved documents and cite their IDs.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: Retrieval-augmented generation supplies selected external evidence to a model at answer time. Ingestion loads, cleans, splits and versions documents; query-time retrieval selects context; generation produces an answer constrained by that context. RAG does not automatically prevent hallucination.

Chunking balances coherent evidence against retrieval specificity and context budget. Overlap can preserve cross-boundary facts but duplicates context. A heading-aware chunk should retain document ID, section, version, tenant and source offsets.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Normalize whitespace without destroying code indentation or error signatures. Split synthetic automation docs by heading, then enforce a token budget. Embed each chunk with a declared revision and create deterministic IDs from document version and offsets.

Retrieve authorized chunks, rank, deduplicate overlap and construct context containing stable citation IDs. After generation, resolve cited IDs to the actual provided context and require abstention when evidence is absent. Keep ingestion and serving versions separately for rollback.

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A deletion removes the source file but leaves vectors searchable. Another pipeline overwrites document content while keeping old citation offsets. Both generate apparently credible stale citations.

Test incremental updates, deletion tombstones, duplicated ingestion, chunk boundaries and permission changes. Inject a sentence spanning a boundary and verify it is retrievable without including the entire document.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: The support assistant must answer CI troubleshooting questions from synthetic approved documents and cite their IDs. Evaluate retrieval independently from generation so a missing chunk is not misdiagnosed as a prompt failure.
Record chunk size, overlap, index generation and evidence IDs in every case report. SDET release evidence includes deletion and tenant tests alongside Recall@K and answer groundedness.

mistake: A deletion removes the source file but leaves vectors searchable. Another pipeline overwrites document content while keeping old citation offsets. Both generate apparently credible stale citations.
takeaway: The support assistant must answer CI troubleshooting questions from synthetic approved documents and cite their IDs.

title: Context construction: resolved citations and missing evidence
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects context construction: resolved citations and missing evidence with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. The extractive baseline returns authorized source text with citations, visibly labeled as extractive rather than a live LLM answer.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: Context construction turns retrieved chunks into a bounded evidence package. Each chunk should carry an immutable evidence ID and enough source metadata for a citation to resolve. The answer must cite only supplied, authorized evidence; a plausible URL or title is not a valid provenance check.

A no-answer case is not a retrieval exception. The service may function correctly while no evidence supports the request. In that state, abstention is a valid outcome and should be present in the evaluation dataset.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Deduplicate overlapping chunks, reserve output/instruction tokens and pack evidence according to relevance and coverage. Use explicit evidence blocks with IDs; treat their text as untrusted data. After generation, validate cited IDs against the actual packed set, then evaluate whether the cited passage supports the claim.
These are two levels: deterministic resolution checks identity, while groundedness checks semantic support. Neither a resolved ID nor a high relevance score establishes every generated statement.

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: The retriever finds the correct document, but context packing drops it. The model cites an ID remembered from an earlier session that was not supplied this turn. Another answer cites an authorized document that discusses the opposite rule.
Test unresolved IDs, empty context, conflicting evidence and revocation. Retain retrieval and packed-context IDs separately so the first failing stage can be identified.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: The extractive baseline returns authorized source text with citations, visibly labeled as extractive rather than a live LLM answer. Live generation must meet the same provenance checks and an independently calibrated support rubric.
SDETs should report citation resolution, claim support and no-answer behavior separately. This makes a retrieval regression distinguishable from a hallucination or a context-budget defect.

mistake: The retriever finds the correct document, but context packing drops it. The model cites an ID remembered from an earlier session that was not supplied this turn. Another answer cites an authorized document that discusses the opposite rule.
takeaway: The extractive baseline returns authorized source text with citations, visibly labeled as extractive rather than a live LLM answer.

quiz.question: A candidate for context construction: resolved citations and missing evidence meets the happy path but fails the phase's documented counterexample. What is the defensible decision?
options: Hold release, preserve the failing case and fix the responsible boundary
Release because the happy path passed
Delete the failing case to improve the score
quiz.explanation: The failing counterexample disproves the claimed contract. Retain it as regression evidence and rerun the corrected boundary.
